events.verdict: Curry (GSW) attempts to align himself alongside Sheppard's (HOU) path, and the contact that occurs as Sheppard veers into Curry is marginal.
Moody (GSW) brushes Sheppard's (HOU) left arm after he has removed his left hand from the ball, and the contact is marginal.
Curry (GSW) loses the ball on his own, and he and Sengun (HOU) go to the floor as they attempt to secure possession.
